name: review-ef-migration
title_zh: SQLite 迁移先看数据风险再放行的 EF Cor
tagline_zh: 在 dotnet ef migrations add 之后、apply 之前，替你揪出会丢数据。
tagline_en: After you add a migration but before you apply it, this skill flags data loss risks, snapshot mismatches, and.
desc_en: Revisa migrations do Entity Framework Core antes da aplicação, com foco em risco para dados, coerência com entidade e model snapshot e limitações do provedor SQLite. Use quando uma migration for criada ou alterada.
why_zh: 它不只看语法，而是拿实体、快照和 SQLite 能力边界做三角校验。
why_en: It cross-checks entities, snapshot, and SQLite limits—so you catch what compiles but shouldn't ship.
limit_zh: 只审 EF Core 迁移文件；不检查运行时性能、索引调优或非 SQLite 数据库。
limit_en: Only reviews EF Core migration files; no runtime perf, index tuning, or non-SQLite DBs; requires dotnet CLI and migration files locally.
title_en: EF Core migration reviewer that checks data risk before.
